brief: A pattern is a function of time: it tells which events happen in cycle 0, cycle 1, and so on, written in a small mini-notation.
detail: The notation is that of TidalCycles: words in a sequence share the cycle equally, ~ is a rest, [a b] a group, <a b c> alternates one step per cycle, a*2 and a/2 speed a step up or down, a? plays about half the cycles. Fast, Slow, Rev, Every and Off build a new pattern out of the old one, in place, and return the pattern so they chain. The class knows no domain: what a word means belongs to a subclass such as stzSoundPattern. A text that does not parse never raises: IsValid says so and LastError tells why.
